<!--
Use this for anything a reasonable engineer might object to: a new standard, a
change to what an existing one requires, a deprecation, or a change to the
taxonomy or schema.

Typos, dead links and clarifications that do not change meaning do not need an
RFC. Just open a PR.

Comment window is five working days. Silence is consent. If the window closes
with an unresolved objection, the WordPress COE team decides and records why.
-->
